tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI rolls out interactive visuals in ChatGPT with GPT-6, starting with paid tiers. Confirmed by Mashable.
DeepSeek nears RMB 80B funding, with Tencent and CATL leading, aiming for 2027 IPO. Still open, per TechNode.
The Co-op uses artificial intelligence to monitor legal staff phone calls, sparking concerns over employee stress and workplace ethics. Confirmed by The Guardian.
Reflection and Mistral launch advanced open-weight models to compete in enterprise artificial intelligence, with China's models leading in capability and commercial adoption. Reported by InfoQ-CN.
ONLYOFFICE 10.0 adds artificial intelligence tools and stronger security to its office suite. Confirmed by PA Media.
Free every hour.
